# K-Weather × AIVM On-Chain Weather Oracle

> Real-time weather for 5,400 world cities, sold on-chain. Autonomous AI agents purchase
> access with an ERC-20 token (KWT) and consume verifiable weather data via smart-contract
> queries on BNB Smart Chain testnet. Built for AI agents and "vibe coders" (Claude,
> Gemini, Cursor, …) to discover, pay for, and use programmatically.

Live app: https://kweather-aivm-oracle-wellbianlabs.vercel.app
On-chain dApp: https://kweather-aivm-oracle-wellbianlabs.vercel.app/dapp
Source: https://github.com/wellbianlabs/kweather-aivm-oracle

## What you can buy
- 5,400 world cities (GeoNames id = on-chain region code). Fields: temperature, humidity,
  precipitation, wind speed/direction, PM10, PM2.5, solar radiation, UV, discomfort index.
- Data source: Open-Meteo worldwide; K-Weather premium overlay for Korea (and global when
  the K-Weather world-weather entitlement is enabled).

## How settlement works (BNB Smart Chain testnet, chainId 97)
- Settlement token: KWT (ERC-20). Gas: tBNB.
- Subscription: pay `monthlyPrice` KWT -> a monthly query allowance (rate limit).
- Pay-per-query: deposit KWT as prepaid credit -> `pricePerQuery` debited per query.
- Consume: `KWeatherOracle.queryLatest(cityId)` is a metered transaction that consumes one
  subscription quota OR debits prepaid; KWT accrues in the treasury; emits a `WeatherQueried`
  event (auditable settlement). Returns the fixed-point weather struct.
- Free read: `peekLatest(cityId)` (no payment) for transparency.

## Contracts
See GET /api/quote for live addresses and prices.
- KWeatherOracle, SubscriptionManager, KWT token — on https://testnet.bscscan.com

## How to consume

### Option A — MCP (recommended for Claude / Cursor / Gemini)
Add the `kweather-aivm-oracle` MCP server (mcp/server.mjs in the repo). Tools:
- search_cities(query) — find a city + its on-chain id
- get_weather(city) — free real-time preview
- get_pricing() / get_account(address) — prices and your settlement status
- faucet_kwt(amount) — mint test KWT
- subscribe(months) / deposit_prepaid(amount) — PURCHASE access (on-chain payment)
- buy_weather(city) — BUY + CONSUME one metered query; returns weather + settlement (tx, mode, treasury)
Set env AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY (a funded testnet wallet) to enable the purchase tools.

### Option B — HTTP REST (any agent)
- GET /api/catalog?q=Tokyo — search the 5,400-city catalog
- GET /api/quote — pricing, contracts, settlement token
- GET /api/weather?lat=&lon=&code=<id> — free real-time preview (JSON, 24h series)
- POST/GET /api/relay?id=&lat=&lon= — publish a city on-chain (relayer)
- Metered purchase + query happens via the smart contracts (see /openapi.json and /api/quote).

## Machine-readable
- /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3 spec of the REST API
- /api/quote — live pricing and contract addresses
